groups.summary: UNRESOLVED common mechanism. Six segments span six distinct tasks (alphabet-soup/tomato-sauce basket, stove+moka pot, mugs-on-plates, two-moka-pots-on-stove, mug-in-microwave, mug+pudding) with materially different trajectories: task 0 shows no verified grasp near cooktop; task 2 shows stove lit but no verified pot grasp; task 4 shows a red cup vanishing with empty gripper thereafter; task 8 shows two pots reducing to one with no verified placement; task 9 shows a yellow mug held throughout but never placed in the microwave. The only shared signature is model-call-budget termination with task incomplete, which is a Harness-level artifact, not a pixel-grounded failure mechanism. No merge into a concrete mechanism and no mechanism-based split are supported by the sampled pixels; the deterministic unresolved grouping is retained.

visual_evidence.claim: Medoid task 0: robot repeatedly approaches cooktop/moka-pot area with no verified grasp; task incomplete. No shared mechanism with other tasks visible.
Task 2: cooktop ring turns red (stove lit) but no verified grasp of moka pot; trajectory differs from task 0 and task 4.
Task 4: red cup disappears at step 64 with empty gripper thereafter; distinct object-loss trajectory, not a shared grasp/placement mechanism.
Task 8: two moka pots reduce to one visible; gripper near dark tapered object with no verified placement; distinct from other tasks.
Task 9: yellow mug held throughout but never placed in microwave; retention/placement divergence distinct from other tasks.
Success comparator (task 1, cream cheese + butter in basket) is a different task and provides no mechanism contrast for the six failure segments.
